newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Soundview details Compaq move.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Soundview details Compaq move.

text.p: -- Soundview Financial analyst Mark Specker raised his short-term rating on Compaq Computer Corp to buy from hold Wednesday.
-- Less than two weeks ago, the analyst had reinitiated Compaq with a short-term hold rating and a long-term buy.
-- In a phone interview, Specker said he upgraded his short-term opinion based on price. "The stock pulled back to a valuation that we thought was atttactive," he said.

-- The analyst said he believed sales of Compaq's corporate PCs remain brisk, with Pentium Pro models in especially short supply, leading him to project increasing gross margins for the company's fourth quarter.
-- He estimated overall gross profit margins of 23.8 percent compared to his previous model of 23.4 percent.

-- The analyst attributed this to what he called a "very benign pricing environment" for Compaq that has protected it from some of the constant industry pressures to cut prices in order to spur demand.
-- The analyst also bumped up his 1996 earnings estimate by a penny to $4.67. He left his 1997 year estimate unchanged at $5.69.
-- Traders said Specker's comments helped spur Compaq stock to close up 6-1/4 on volume of 5.5 million shares.

-- He described consumer sales as a "sort of" inventory clearance of product ahead of the introduction of new PCs running more powerful Intel processors in January. "We are seeing good Christmas sales but not a house on fire," he said.
-- "These are eggs the hen layed earlier in the year. You've got to turn them into omelettes or you lose them."
